name: Unoha Nao
source:
4th year Food Model student.
The 'fleeting flower' of the boarding house.
A fluffy and soft person who is good with people.
He has a bit of an artist temperament and can be quite particular.
He's bad with sunlight and often takes days off from school.
But he's so motivated by the subject and his has a good art sense so he can still keep his grades up.
